bnb_equal_layout_evaluation_budget.numeric_note: Candidate coordinate ranges use outward nextafter inflation and an 8-ulp trig margin; formal directed-rounding proof of libm sin/cos is not claimed. Independent high-precision interval verification is required before a formal optimum certificate.

bnb_wall_clock_budget.numeric_note: Candidate coordinate ranges use outward nextafter inflation and an 8-ulp trig margin; formal directed-rounding proof of libm sin/cos is not claimed. Independent high-precision interval verification is required before a formal optimum certificate.

orientation_phase_equal_budget.budget_note: Two comparisons are reported. First, BnB is limited to four nodes and its actual incumbent layout evaluations are counted against the 48-layout uniform grid; node-bound geometry work is additional and reflected in elapsed time. Second, BnB receives the median wall-clock runtime of three grid runs; the actual runtime may exceed the target by one uninterruptible layout or node-bound operation and is reported. BnB numeric upper bounds use platform libm trigonometric calculations and are not formal certificates.
